items.title: Property C plus closedness implies almost cocontinuity of the base change functor
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that if for every etale V over Y the base change X x_Y V -> V has property (C) and is closed, then the base change functor Y_etale -> X_etale is almost cocontinuous (statement lines 6131-6143, with property (C) delivered verbatim as a context span from lines 5708-5726). The proof applies property (C) to the base changes in order to produce a covering refining the given one (proof lines 6145-6152) and uses closedness to descend the refinement to the base (proof lines 6152-6159), which is exactly the almost cocontinuity condition. The non-formal content is the descent step, where closedness is used. The claim is H2: one application of the hypothesis plus one descent.
